usedFor: ScrapingBee reads web pages, and “Scrape Webpage” pulls a page's content into a step.

bestTemplate.name: “Scrape Webpage” in ScrapingBee
bestTemplate.why: It scrapes a webpage, with headless browsers and proxies handled for you.

watchOut: AI agents run on a schedule or when asked, so a scrape happens then, not on each page change.
